mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 10% signals labor market weakness, reducing corporate investment and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 10% in the trigger period, or S&P 500 forward returns remain negative despite the rate increase (p < 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices above 1% signals a balanced economy, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of GDPC1 and INDPRO does not occur (both do not rise >1% simultaneously) in >60% of triggered instances, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in CPIAUCSL inflation alongside persistent FEDFUNDS rate cuts creates accommodative conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not a late-cycle expansion, or returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in HOUST demand metrics above 600 units indicates growing consumer demand, stimulating corporate investment and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST does not rise above 600 units in the next 5 days, or returns are not positive (p <0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PAYEMS labor participation above 130,000 indicates a tight labor market, spurring wage growth and corporate hiring, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not rise above 130,000 in the next 20 days, or returns are not positive (p <0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% and a sustained drop in UNRATE below 5% signals dual monetary easing and labor market strength, fostering investment and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS does not fall below 1% or UNRATE does not drop below 5% in the required period, or returns are not significantly positive (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% alongside rising GDPC1 demand metrics indicates improved macro conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not post-shock recovery, or returns are not significantly positive (p >0.05) despite the macro conditions.
